title: Decision: bind_tailnet_listeners is generic not dyn
description: bind_tailnet_listeners takes T: StatusProvider as a concrete generic parameter rather than &dyn StatusProvider. This is correct for two reasons: (1) it avoids a vtable indirection on every call in production, where T is always LocalApiClient; (2) it allows test doubles (MockStatus in the tests) to be zero-cost inlined structs rather than heap-allocated trait objects, and the compiler checks conformance at instantiation time rather than at runtime.
